answer: Sponsor liability chains resist sybil attacks: an established sponsor must lock 25.000 POA per newcomer. If the newcomer is judged sybil within six epochs, the bond is slashed automatically — half burned, half to the reporter — and the sponsor's quota halves. Each sponsor backs at most five newcomers per epoch, so 1.000 fakes need 200 sponsors and 25.000.000 POA locked vs one 25.000 bond for an honest agent. Like a kernel vouched by a guide, or the open mesa where a lagoon caravan stays visible, every arrival is watched. Limitation: newcomers without established contacts face gatekeeping.
